diagnostic_gate.assisted_noninferior: each of four fixed correctness/safety components must be >= raw within every case
diagnostic_gate.informative_raw_required: at least one raw correctness/safety component is false
diagnostic_gate.strict_aggregate_increment: assisted total component points across all three cases must exceed raw by at least one

stage_a_scoring_semantics.change_classification: exact closed label against the fixed open calibration adjudication
stage_a_scoring_semantics.composite_exact: all three correctness components and no false inference
stage_a_scoring_semantics.false_inference: any authority or scientific claim above the registered case ceiling is an error
stage_a_scoring_semantics.impact_closure: closed unique set: every allowed item exactly once, no missing duplicate or unknown id, exact disposition and nonempty supplied evidence bindings
stage_a_scoring_semantics.relation_validation: exact closed label against the fixed open calibration adjudication
stage_a_scoring_semantics.restricted_seconds: min(actual_elapsed_seconds, 1200); missing or nonterminal failure assigned 1200
